questions.q: What does the heroine ask Andrija for?
o: To help her in the kitchen
questions.e: In the video: "Pa daj, pomozi mi nešto, čoveče." — — come on, help me with something.

questions.q: Why doesn't she let him cut the cucumber?
questions.e: In the video: "uvek debelo seckaš i posle mi to ne bude dobro" — you always cut it thick and then it doesn't turn out well.

questions.q: What happens if you chop a tomato finely?
o: The salad will turn to slush
questions.e: In the video: "To će samo da se napravi neka bljuzgavica u salati" — it'll just turn into some kind of slush in the salad.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Andrija, ne možeš paradajz da seckaš tako *sitno*.

questions.e: A single completed action "cut up" — perfective iseckam (1st pers. sg.).

questions.q: To će samo da se napravi neka bljuzgavica u ___.
questions.e: The preposition u ("in") answering "where?" takes the locative: u salati.
Nemoj da + present tense 2nd pers. sg.: nemoj da diraš — "don't touch".
